blocks.text: Dehumidifiers in Alamo Heights, TX, can completely transform the comfort level of your home. A dehumidifier for a house can be integrated into your central AC system, and individual units for each room are also available. Whether you are dealing with a lot of extra moisture that is contributing to mold or just feel a bit uncomfortable, we can help.

A dehumidification system draws the water out of the air in your home. Excess moisture can make your home feel stuffy and uncomfortable. A dehumidifier for a house provides a lot of help with mold, mildew, and issues with allergies. Using these devices will also reduce strain on your AC system, helping it work more efficiently and last longer. In addition, keeping high humidity in check will help to prevent property damage to wallpaper, furniture, and even brickwork.

So, what is the ideal humidity level for your home? While every home is different, a humidity level between 30% and 40% is ideal for maintaining your comfort in the winter. In the summer, an indoor humidity level between 50% and 60% is ideal. Anything above 60% can lead to mold growth and the other issues mentioned above. An Indoor Air Quality expert can measure your humidity level and suggest solutions to address humidity issues.

There are two main types of dehumidification systems available: whole-home systems and portable units. Whole-home systems work with your HVAC units to reduce humidity throughout your indoor spaces. Portable units can be moved from room to room and are great for targeted humidity control.
There are several rooms in your home that may benefit from a dehumidifier:BathroomsBedroomsBasementsLaundry roomsBedrooms
